Dialogue_Text: You... I have sworn that I will never give up, monster! The heavens are on my side, and I know that I won't be left alone! You shall meet my trusted blade and realize that there is but one fate that awaits you.
I am sorry, but I think you are destined to fall. But I can learn from you. From your mistakes.
Hah! You are but a foolish man, and you don't understand that this is but a tale that ends tragically for you.
Your blade... it looks like my Celestial Fury, just somewhat more... dim.
I won't listen to you, monster! Let's end this!
This... this is some kind of trick, isn't it? It doesn't matter. Let's just end this!
